violations.text: Raw animal foods (such as beef patties) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as pasta salad and produce) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Food items were rearranged during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026

The door to the kitchen toilet room is not self-closing. Toilet room doors that open to food preparation spaces shall be self-closing to prevent potential contamination. New Violation. Correct By: 10/02/2025
